attributes.name: Jaagrath Kreeg
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, Jaagrath Kreeg deals 1 Combat damage to each other character at your location.

If your character has the Human trait, the difficulty of checks to defeat Jaagrath is increased by 2.

If undefeated, Jaagrath Kreeg deals 1 Combat damage to each other character at your location.

"You're a pretty one. Come kiss my hook!"—Jaagrath Kreeg
